themes.why: Money leaving crowded AI trades went to large, diversified drugmakers. Earnings are strong (Lilly Q1 sales +56% on GLP-1s, AbbVie's new Skyrizi data), the April 2026 tariff on patented drugs exempts companies that signed White House pricing deals, and 2026 healthcare M&A is on course for its highest since 2019.
themes.evidence: AbbVie closed at a record in mid-October; hedge-fund healthcare exposure near a 5-year high
themes.india: CDMO / CRDMO gains most: cash-rich big pharma outsources more, and the BIOSECURE provisions push work away from Chinese CDMOs. Generics do not share in it; the US tariff on generics rises to 100% from August 2028.
